title: cultivation_of_commoner_001_Chapter 1 The Village by the Mountain

content.src: 二愣子睁大着双眼，直直望着茅草和烂泥糊成的黑屋顶，身上盖着的旧棉被，已呈深黄色，看不出原来的本来面目，还若有若无的散着淡淡的霉味
content.target: Er Lengzi stared wide-eyed at the black roof made of straw and mud. The old quilt covering him had turned deep yellow, its original color long gone, and it faintly gave off a musty smell.

content.src: 在他身边紧挨着的另一人，是二哥韩铸，酣睡的十分香甜，从他身上不时传来轻重不一的阵阵打呼声
content.target: Next to him, pressed close, was his second brother Han Zhu, sleeping soundly. From him came uneven snores, sometimes loud, sometimes soft.

content.src: 离床大约半丈远的地方，是一堵黄泥糊成的土墙，因为时间过久，墙壁上裂开了几丝不起眼的细长口子，从这些裂纹中，隐隐约约的传来韩母唠唠叨叨的埋怨声，偶尔还掺杂着韩父，抽旱烟杆的“啪嗒”“啪嗒”吸允声
content.target: About half a zhang away from the bed was a dirt wall covered with yellow mud. Over time, the wall had cracked with thin, barely noticeable lines. Through these cracks, the faint sound of Han's mother's constant complaints could be heard, occasionally mixed with the 'puff-puff' sound of Han's father smoking his pipe.

content.src: 二愣子缓缓的闭上已有些涩的双目，迫使自己尽早进入深深的睡梦中
content.target: Er Lengzi slowly closed his tired eyes, forcing himself to fall into a deep sleep as soon as possible.

content.src: 他心里非常清楚，再不老实入睡的话，明天就无法早起些了，也就无法和其他约好的同伴一起进山拣干柴
content.target: He knew very well that if he didn't sleep properly, he wouldn't be able to wake up early the next day and join his friends to gather firewood in the mountains.

content.src: 二愣子姓韩名立，这么像模像样的名字,他父母可起不出来，这是他父亲用两个粗粮制成的窝头，求村里老张叔给起的名字
content.target: Er Lengzi's full name was Han Li. Such a proper name was beyond what his parents could come up with. His father had traded two coarse grain buns to Old Zhang, the village elder, to give him this name.

content.src: 老张叔年轻时，曾经跟城里的有钱人当过几年的伴读书童，是村里唯一认识几个字的读书人，村里小孩子的名字，倒有一多半是他给起的
content.target: Old Zhang had once been a study companion for a wealthy family in the city when he was young. He was the only literate person in the village, and more than half of the children's names in the village were given by him.

content.src: 韩立被村里人叫作“二愣子”，可人并不是真愣真傻，反而是村中屈一指的聪明孩子，但就像其他村中的孩子一样，除了家里人外，他就很少听到有人正式叫他名字“韩立”，倒是“二愣子”“二愣子”的称呼一直伴随至今
content.target: Though Han Li was called 'Er Lengzi' by the villagers, he wasn't actually foolish. In fact, he was one of the smartest kids in the village. But like other village children, apart from his family, he rarely heard anyone call him by his real name 'Han Li.' Instead, the nickname 'Er Lengzi' had stuck with him.

content.src: 而之所以被人起了个“二愣子”的绰号，也只不过是因为村里已有一个叫“愣子”的孩子了
content.target: The reason he got the nickname 'Er Lengzi' was simply because there was already a child in the village called 'Lengzi.'

content.src: 这也没啥，村里的其他孩子也是“狗娃”“二蛋”之类的被人一直称呼着，这些名字也不见得比“二愣子”好听了哪里去
content.target: This wasn't unusual. Other village kids were also called names like 'Dog Boy' or 'Second Egg.' These names weren't any better than 'Er Lengzi.'

content.src: 因此，韩立虽然并不喜欢这个称呼，但也只能这样一直的自我安慰着
content.target: Therefore, although Han Li didn't like this nickname, he could only comfort himself this way.

content.src: 韩立外表长得很不起眼，皮肤黑黑的，就是一个普通的农家小孩模样
content.target: Han Li had a very ordinary appearance, with dark skin, just like a typical farm boy.

content.src: 但他的内心深处，却比同龄人早熟了许多，他从小就向往外面世界的富饶繁华，梦想有一天，他能走出这个巴掌大的村子，去看看老张叔经常所说的外面世界
content.target: But deep down, he was much more mature than his peers. Since childhood, he had longed for the richness and excitement of the outside world, dreaming that one day he could leave this tiny village and see the world that Old Zhang often talked about.

content.src: 当韩立的这个想法，一直没敢和其他人说起过
content.target: Han Li never dared to share this thought with anyone else.

content.src: 否则，一定会使村里人感到愕然，一个乳臭未干的小屁孩，竟然会有这么一个大人也不敢轻易想的念头
content.target: Otherwise, it would surely shock the villagers—how could a little kid have such a bold idea that even adults wouldn’t easily consider?

content.src: 要知道，其他同韩立差不多大的小孩，都还只会满村的追鸡摸狗，更别说会有离开故土，这么一个古怪的念头
content.target: After all, other kids his age were still busy chasing chickens and dogs around the village, let alone having such a strange thought of leaving their hometown.

content.src: 韩立一家七口人，有两个兄长，一个姐姐，还有一个小妹，他在家里排行老四，今年刚十岁，家里的生活很清苦，一年也吃不上几顿带荤腥的饭菜，全家人一直在温饱线上徘徊着
content.target: Han Li's family had seven members: two older brothers, an older sister, and a younger sister. He was the fourth child, just ten years old. Life was tough, with the family barely making ends meet, rarely having meat in their meals.

content.src: 此时的韩立，正处于迷迷糊糊，似睡未睡之间，恼中还一直残留着这样的念头：上山时，一定要帮他最疼爱的妹妹，多拣些她最喜欢吃的红浆果
content.target: At this moment, Han Li was half-asleep, still holding onto the thought: when he went up the mountain, he must pick more of his beloved sister’s favorite red berries.

content.src: 第二天中午时分，当韩立顶着火辣辣的太阳，背着半人高的木柴堆，怀里还揣着满满一布袋浆果，从山里往家里赶的时侯，并不知道家中已来了一位，会改变他一生命运的客人
content.target: The next noon, as Han Li walked home under the scorching sun, carrying a pile of firewood half his height and a bag full of berries, he had no idea that a guest—who would change his life forever—had arrived at his home.

content.src: 这位贵客，是跟他血缘很近的一位至亲，他的亲三叔
content.target: This important guest was a close relative—his own third uncle.

content.src: 听说，在附近一个小城的酒楼，给人当大掌柜，是他父母口中的大能人
content.target: It is said that in a small town nearby, he works as the manager of a restaurant and is considered a capable person by his parents.

content.src: 韩家近百年来，可能就出了三叔这么一位有点身份的亲戚
content.target: In the Han family, over the past hundred years, Uncle might be the only relative with some status.

content.src: 韩立只在很小的时侯，见过这位三叔几次
content.target: Han Li only met this uncle a few times when he was very young.

content.src: 他大哥在城里给一位老铁匠当学徒的工作，就是这位三叔给介绍的，这位三叔还经常托人给他父母捎带一些吃的用的东西，很是照顾他们一家，因此韩立对这位三叔的印像也很好，知道父母虽然嘴里不说，心里也是很感激的
content.target: His older brother's apprenticeship with an old blacksmith in the city was arranged by this uncle, who also often sent food and supplies to his parents. The family was very grateful, and Han Li had a good impression of him.

content.src: 大哥可是一家人的骄傲，听说当铁匠的学徒，不但管吃管住，一个月还有三十个铜板拿，等到正式出师被人雇用时，挣的钱可就更多了
content.target: His brother was the pride of the family. As a blacksmith's apprentice, he not only had food and lodging but also earned thirty copper coins a month. Once he became a full-fledged craftsman, he would earn even more.

content.src: 每当父母一提起大哥，就神采飞扬，像换了一个人一样
content.target: Whenever his parents talked about his brother, they would light up with pride, as if they were different people.

content.src: 韩立年龄虽小，也羡慕不已，心目最好的工作也早早就有了，就是给小城里的哪位手艺师傅看上，收做学徒，从此变成靠手艺吃饭的体面人
content.target: Though young, Han Li admired his brother and dreamed of being taken in as an apprentice by a skilled craftsman in town, so he could become a respectable worker.

content.src: 所以当韩立见到穿着一身崭新的缎子衣服，胖胖的圆脸，留着一撮小胡子的三叔时，心里兴奋极了
content.target: So when Han Li saw his uncle—wearing a shiny satin outfit, with a round, chubby face and a small mustache—he was extremely excited.

content.src: 把木柴在屋后放好后，便到前屋腼腆的给三叔见了个礼，乖乖的叫了声：“三叔好”，就老老实实的站在一边，听父母同三叔聊天
content.target: After putting the firewood behind the house, he shyly greeted his uncle in the front room, saying politely, "Hello, Uncle," then stood quietly to listen to their conversation.

content.src: 三叔笑眯眯的望着韩立，打量着他一番，嘴里夸了他几句“听话”“懂事”之类的话，然后就转过头，和他父母说起这次的来意
content.target: Uncle smiled at Han Li, looked him over, praised him for being "well-behaved" and "sensible," then turned to his parents to explain the reason for his visit.

content.src: 韩立虽然年龄尚小，不能完全听懂三叔的话，但也听明白了大概的意思
content.target: Although Han Li was still young and couldn't fully understand his uncle's words, he grasped the general idea.

content.src: 原来三叔工作的酒楼，属于一个叫“七玄门”的江湖门派所有，这个门派有外门和内门之分，而前不久，三叔才正式成为了这个门派的外门弟子，能够推举7岁到12岁的孩童去参加七玄门招收内门弟子的考验
content.target: It turned out that the restaurant where his uncle worked belonged to a martial arts sect called 'Seven Mysteries Sect.' This sect had an outer and inner division, and not long ago, his uncle officially became an outer disciple, allowing him to recommend children aged 7 to 12 to take the test for becoming inner disciples.

content.src: 五年一次的“七玄门”招收内门弟子测试，下个月就要开始了
content.target: The 'Seven Mysteries Sect' test for recruiting inner disciples, held once every five years, would begin next month.

content.src: 这位有着几分精明劲自己尚无子女的三叔，自然想到了适龄的韩立
content.target: This somewhat shrewd uncle, who had no children of his own, naturally thought of Han Li, who was the right age.

content.src: 一向老实巴交的韩父，听到“江湖”“门派”之类的从未听闻过的话，心里有些犹豫不决拿不定主意
content.target: Han Li's father, usually simple and honest, felt hesitant and uncertain upon hearing unfamiliar terms like 'martial arts' and 'sect.'

content.src: 便一把拿起旱烟杆，“吧嗒”“吧嗒”的狠狠抽了几口，就坐在那里，一声不吭
content.target: He picked up his long pipe, took a few deep puffs, and sat there silently.

content.src: 在三叔嘴里，“七玄门”自然是这方圆数百里内，了不起的、数一数二的大门派
content.target: According to his uncle, the 'Seven Mysteries Sect' was undoubtedly one of the most prestigious sects within hundreds of miles.

content.src: 只要成为内门弟子，不但以后可以免费习武吃喝不愁，每月还能有一两多的散银子零花
content.target: Becoming an inner disciple not only meant free martial arts training and no worries about food but also a monthly allowance of over one tael of silver.

content.src: 而且参加考验的人，即使未能入选也有机会成为像三叔一样的外门人员，专门替“七玄门”打理门外的生意
content.target: Even those who didn't pass the test could still become outer members like his uncle, managing the sect's external business.

content.src: 当听到有可能每月有一两银子可拿，还有机会成为和三叔一样的体面人，韩父终于拿定了主意，答应了下来
content.target: When Han Li's father heard about the possible monthly silver and the chance to become a respectable person like his uncle, he finally made up his mind and agreed.

content.src: 三叔见到韩父应承了下来，心里很是高兴
content.target: Third Uncle was very happy to see Han's father agree.

content.src: 又留下几两银子，说一个月后就来带韩立走，在这期间给韩立多做点好吃的，给他补补身子，好应付考验
content.target: He left a few taels of silver and said he would come back in a month to take Han Li away. During this time, he asked them to prepare good food for Han Li to strengthen his body for the upcoming test.

content.src: 随后三叔和韩父打声招呼，摸了摸韩立的头，出门回城了
content.target: Then, Third Uncle said goodbye to Han's father, patted Han Li's head, and left for the city.

content.src: 韩立虽然不全明白三叔所说的话，但可以进城能挣大钱还是明白的
content.target: Although Han Li didn't fully understand what Third Uncle said, he knew that going to the city could earn him a lot of money.

content.src: 一直以来的愿望，眼看就有可能实现，他一连好几个晚上兴奋的睡不着觉
content.target: His long-time wish seemed about to come true, and he was so excited that he couldn't sleep for several nights.

content.src: 三叔在一个多月后，准时的来到村中，要带韩立走了，临走前韩父反复嘱咐韩立，做人要老实，遇事要忍让，别和其他人起争执，而韩母则要他多注意身体，要吃好睡好
content.target: More than a month later, Third Uncle arrived in the village on time to take Han Li away. Before leaving, Han's father repeatedly told Han Li to be honest, patient, and avoid conflicts with others, while his mother reminded him to take care of his health, eat well, and sleep well.

content.src: 在马车上，看着父母渐渐远去的身影，韩立咬紧了嘴唇，强忍着不让自己眼框中的泪珠流出来
content.target: On the carriage, watching his parents' figures fade into the distance, Han Li bit his lip hard to hold back the tears in his eyes.

content.src: 他虽然从小就比其他孩子成熟的多，但毕竟还是个十岁的小孩，第一次出远门让他的心里有点伤感和彷徨
content.target: Although he had always been more mature than other children, he was still just a ten-year-old boy. Leaving home for the first time made him feel sad and lost.

content.src: 他年幼的心里暗暗下定了决心，等挣到了大钱就马上赶回来，和父母再也不分开
content.target: In his young heart, he secretly made a decision: once he earned enough money, he would return immediately and never be apart from his parents again.

content.src: 韩立从未想到，此次出去后钱财的多少对他已失去了意义，他竟然走上了一条与凡人不同的仙业大道，走出了自己的修仙之路
content.target: Han Li never imagined that after leaving, money would lose its meaning to him. Instead, he would embark on a different path—a path of immortality, walking his own journey of cultivation.
